title: Connect an existing native chat from Studio
taskScope: Owner selects an existing Codex chat, sends a request tied to an ordinary step, and observes actual host receipt/reply without shell commands.

actors.name: Project owner
actors.goal: Delegate a step to an existing native chat

preconditions: Authenticated owner Runtime with sealed keyring and selected execution/node
Trusted native binary and native SQLite directory configured in Runtime launcher
Existing native thread accepts read/resume without permission or provider overrides

failureContract.visibleError: Native chat is unavailable or its response is unconfirmed.
failureContract.safeStop: Preserve request identity; do not resend, reassign or complete the node.
prohibitedSideEffects: Changing native history, source cwd or permissions
Repeating an uncertain native turn automatically

promises.statement: The actual native catalog is visible and operable.
The selected native thread acknowledges the actual turn tied to request, execution, source project and node.
The bounded actual native reply appears separately from node completion and accepted code delivery.
The original native history and source cwd remain intact.
Retrying the same identity reads its durable result without a duplicate native turn.

outOfScope: Operational node assignment or graph lifecycle completion
Moving a native chat to another project or copying its full transcript
Automatic skill-use or JPD certification from model claims
Restarting busy desktop chats or automatically approving tool requests
